baseline.name: People
baseline.summary: Every person the detector boxed at ingest.

baseline.name: Scene captions
baseline.summary: What the reasoning model wrote about each segment.

modules.name: Restricted lane
modules.summary: Flags a person whose feet stay inside the forklift lane on this camera.
modules.evidence: Cosmos Reason proposes the lane from a camera frame; events are computed from YOLO11 person boxes. Image-space position, not calibrated distance.

modules.name: Near a forklift
modules.summary: Finds segments where the scene caption describes a person close to a forklift.
modules.evidence: VAST hybrid search over Cosmos Reason captions. The match score ranks relevance; it is not a safety confidence.
modules.query: a person standing or walking close to a forklift

modules.name: Lingering
modules.summary: Flags a person who stays in roughly the same spot for too long.
modules.evidence: Computed from YOLO11 person boxes tracked across frames.

modules.name: Crowding
modules.summary: Flags when more people than allowed are visible at once.
modules.evidence: Computed from YOLO11 person counts per frame.

modules.name: Do-not-enter area
modules.summary: Flags a person who goes past a DO NOT ENTER sign into a closed-off area.
modules.evidence: Cosmos Reason checklist in the segment caption, found with VAST search. The match score ranks relevance; it is not a safety confidence.
modules.query: a person walks past a DO NOT ENTER sign into a closed-off area

modules.name: Office entry
modules.summary: Flags a person walking into an office. It cannot tell whether that person is staff.
modules.evidence: Cosmos Reason checklist in the segment caption, found with VAST search. The match score ranks relevance; it is not a safety confidence.
modules.query: a person walks into an office through a door or curtain marked OFFICE

modules.name: Running indoors
modules.summary: Flags a person running inside the building.
modules.evidence: Cosmos Reason checklist in the segment caption, found with VAST search. The match score ranks relevance; it is not a safety confidence.

modules.name: Do-not-move item moved
modules.summary: Flags a person moving furniture marked DO NOT MOVE.
modules.evidence: Cosmos Reason checklist in the segment caption, found with VAST search. The match score ranks relevance; it is not a safety confidence.
modules.query: a person moves or pushes a table marked DO NOT MOVE

modules.name: Fire alarm touched
modules.summary: Flags a person touching or reaching for a fire alarm pull station.
modules.evidence: Cosmos Reason checklist in the segment caption, found with VAST search. The match score ranks relevance; it is not a safety confidence.
modules.query: a person touching a red fire alarm pull station on the wall

modules.name: Lunch not delivered
modules.summary: Flags a food table that has no pizza when the caption describes the lunch setup.
modules.evidence: Cosmos Reason checklist in the segment caption, found with VAST search. The match score ranks relevance; it is not a safety confidence.
modules.query: an empty food serving table with plates and napkins but no pizza

unsupported.topic: PPE such as hard hats, vests, or gloves
unsupported.why: The detector only boxes people; it does not classify protective equipment, and an occluded helmet would be unknown, not missing.

unsupported.topic: vehicle speed or physical distance in metres
unsupported.why: Measuring speed or distance needs calibrated camera geometry, which this archive does not provide.

unsupported.topic: fire, smoke, spills, or blocked exits
unsupported.why: No indexed footage or detector output covers these events.
The YOLO11 COCO detector returns no forklift class on this footage; forklifts are only described in captions.

unsupported.topic: whether someone is staff, a visitor, or authorized
unsupported.why: Video cannot verify identity or permissions. Replay can flag that a person entered an area, for a human to check.

unsupported.topic: who may use a restroom based on gender or appearance
unsupported.why: Replay does not infer gender or other personal traits from appearance. Use a do-not-enter or restricted-room rule instead.

ingest_prompt: Describe this indoor video factually in 2 or 3 sentences: the people and what they do (walking, running, entering a door, room, or curtained area), visible signs and their text, furniture being moved, anyone touching a wall device such as a fire alarm, and food on tables. Then add one final line exactly in this form: CHECKS: running=yes|no; entered_do_not_enter=yes|no; entered_office=yes|no; moved_do_not_move_item=yes|no; touched_fire_alarm=yes|no; pizza_visible=yes|no. Answer no when it is not visible. Do not guess identity, job role, or gender.
